_note: Every UI label lives here. Urdu and Pashto drafted by the team; needs native-speaker review (Person 4, hour 24-30). Keep values short. {placeholders} are filled by app.js.

en.tap_district: Tap a district on the map or in the list.
en.tap_uc: Tap a union council for its ten-day chart and CSV.
en.legend_nodata: Grey: no irrigated winter cereals or missing data
en.legend_note: Deficit = crop water use (ET) minus rainfall, on irrigated winter-cereal land, last ten days. A union council signal, not a farm one.
en.layer_note: Hectares from ESA WorldCereal 2021 at 10 m. Shaded by quintile within this district.
en.status_sentence: Crops used {et} mm of water and received {rain} mm of rain. {ha} ha of irrigated winter cereals under this signal.
en.nodata_no_irrigated: No irrigated winter cereals were mapped here, so no water-balance signal is computed.
en.nodata_missing: A source was missing for this period.
en.trend_up: Deficit has grown {n} dekads in a row.
en.trend_up_one: Deficit grew since the previous dekad.
en.trend_flat: Deficit did not grow since the previous dekad.
en.chart_title: Last six dekads: crop water use vs rainfall
en.no_series: No time series for this unit yet.
en.footer_sources: ESA WorldCereal 2021 · FAO WaPOR v3 · NASA POWER · geoBoundaries
